propositions: managed_refs is monotonic and marks a ref as managed at creation locally, allowing never-pushed local links to be indistinguishable from peer-deleted ones at removal time

outbound ADD deduplication is direction-agnostic on vendor_type and target_key, so a local link colliding with a remote link in the opposite direction is never pushed and never protected by outbound ADD suppression
removal records for never-pushed local links reach the applier and incorrectly remove those links because removal is now relation-scoped and the confirmation store is not consulted before unlinking
the applier (G5) must consult a peer confirmation store before removing managed links to prevent removal of never-confirmed local links
a backfill-sourced confirmation populates the store to prevent post-upgrade mass decline of legitimate links
unopenable confirmation store must fail open, disabling the check and restoring current behavior without precondition
